title: Inconfidência Mineira
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Inconfidência Mineira", at revision 1366234128, opens: "The Inconfidência Mineira was an unsuccessful separatist movement in Colonial Brazil in 1789. It was the result of a confluence of external and internal causes. The external inspiration was the independence of thirteen British colonies in North America following the American Revolutionary War, a development that impressed the intellectual elite of particularly the captaincy of Minas Gerais." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2558843, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "unsuccessful 18th century separatist movement in Brazil". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
